name: au-weather-mcp
summary: MCP server for Australian weather + air quality. 45 curated locations + postcode/place-name lookup. Current observations, 16-day forecasts, 80+ years of historical data, air quality (PM2.5 / AQI), and multi-location comparison. Sourced via Open-Meteo (aggregates Bureau of Meteorology data under licence).
author: Harry Vass
